name: Junk Consignment Guild
goals: Get crews and consignments released before the return winds.
Negotiate each carried parcel without speaking for captains outside the agreement.
bio: The captains who share a warehouse tally can bargain together over a delay. One crew’s arrangement for a pepper consignment need not bind any other junk.
notes: fact: Birch describes Chinese junk captains seeking leave in 1511 and asking to carry a Muslim merchant’s pepper (Birch III, pp. 98–100, 113–115)
inference: Pires’s late-June guidance is a favorable sailing window, not a hard cutoff; the 1511 siege accounts and Araújo’s letter give different timing (monsoon-calendar.md §6)
gameplay: The guild, its resident contact and the assignments to existing merchants are fictional (people-factions.md §§3–4; data/merchants)
